instruction: Move the last slide to become the first slide in the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

text_checks.0: The Purdue OWL Family of Sites

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully duplicated the last two slides and inserted copies in alternating order in LibreOffice Impress, going from 24 to 26 slides. Completed in 38 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slide panel, select slides, duplicate slides, move/reorder slides, save presentation in LibreOffice Impress
metadata.task_rationale: Tests slide reordering by moving a slide to a different position. Model demonstrated slide move capability in the original task, so this variation targets a different reorder pattern.
metadata.explanation: Task requires moving the last slide (slide 24, 'Works Cited' references) to position 1. Evaluator checks: (1) total count still 24 (0.34 pts), (2) first slide contains 'The Purdue OWL Family of Sites' text from original slide 24 (0.33 pts), (3) last slide contains 'Understand the basic elements' text from original slide 23 (0.33 pts).

scoring_breakdown.first_slide_content: 0.33 - First slide contains original slide 24 text
scoring_breakdown.last_slide_content: 0.33 - Last slide contains original slide 23 text
